summary: Prod / = 569 KB raw / 78.0 KB gz (served gzip). By component: dehydrated state 125.8/28.3 KB gz, inline CSS 134.5/18.9, main markup 204/13.4, header 49/7.7 (header is 76.5 KB, not 103), footer 30/5.0. Transforming the saved HTML with the proposals gives 337 KB / 45.6 KB gz core, 297/42.2 stretch; fixture 382/50.3 -> 234/28.9. The 200/35 target is not safely reachable. Interleaved no-JS LH on prod-HTML variants: mobile FCP/LCP unchanged (+-40 ms); TBT median 158 -> 25 ms (N=5); main thread 1508 -> 1260 ms; Style&Layout 401 -> 276. Padding +150 KB adds +0.75 s FCP, so bytes count only once the doc is the long pole. Verdict: a TBT lever (-100..150 ms mobile) that counts after boot-js moves FCP before parse; plus about -35 ms FCP/LCP from CSS literals in High-priority JS.

findings.claim: The dehydrated state is the largest gzip component of the document. It holds the full public site_settings map, all 46 menu rows (only 7 are rendered), the 8 distinct posts repeated in 26 rows with both languages, and the full newsletter row including popup config.
findings.evidence: $tsr-stream-barrier 107041 B + stream 18469 B = 125831 raw / 28268 gz. Measured with decode-all.cjs + barrier_segments.py on psi/home.html.

changes.title: Move static CSS out of JS string literals and inline <style> into real CSS files in the public core CSS
changes.mechanism: Move TickerStyles (TrendingTicker.tsx:820+), slider SHARED_STYLES (sliderVariants.tsx:1103), the globalColors static widget-bridge/sidebar rules (globalColors.ts:863-989; keep only the :root/.dark custom properties in the generated block) and the search-widget sheet into .css files that Vite/lightningcss minifies. Import them into the public core CSS after the existing rules so source order stays the same. Remove the <style> elements from React render on both server and client so SSR matches hydration. Dedupe the identical .sbw social-hover sheet with WidgetStyleSheet (href = content hash).
changes.metric: HTML bytes, pre-LCP JS bytes (FCP/LCP), TBT (parse/style)
changes.expected_effect: HTML -44 KB raw / -8.5 KB gz; entry -14.8 KB raw and sliderVariants -10.9 KB raw (~-6.5 KB gz of High-priority JS), so about -30..40 ms FCP/LCP mobile; minified CSS adds ~+6 KB gz render-blocking (est.); contributes to the measured TBT -100..150 ms together with HW-2
changes.estimate_basis: prod-variants.py css_static step on psi/home.html; literal sizes found in .output/public/assets/index-DPN2YAij.js and sliderVariants-Cl4hnw1I.js; lighthouse-analyst slope of 5.1-6 ms per KB of pre-LCP bytes; no-JS A/B P1->P2 Style&Layout 334-398 -> 264-317 ms
changes.risk_notes: Cascade order: the bridge rules are :where() (0 specificity) and the sidebar rules have attribute specificity. Both must stay after the Tailwind/hand CSS, as they are now (today they sit inline in body). The slider sheet currently uses precedence='builder' hoisting, so client navigation must still have the CSS; a global import guarantees that. The ticker CSS lands on every chrome page (it was already inline on every page).
changes.verification: Computed-style parity probe (Playwright, fixture artifact, 390/820/1350 px, light+dark): empty diff. check-document-weight inlineStyleBytes drops ~44 KB. check:bundle shows entry and sliderVariants smaller. measure-ab.sh: mobile main-thread down, TBT not worse.

changes.title: Per-widget typography CSS -> one static template plus CSS custom properties on the widget element
changes.mechanism: Replace buildWidgetTypographyCss output (typographyCss.ts:91-228) with (1) 26 static template rules in public CSS that keep today's 3-attribute specificity and !important, gated by data-wt~=token so an unset var() can never override; (2) per-instance style='--wt-tfs-d:16px;--wt-dfs-d:12px…' plus data-wt tokens. Device values are chosen by static @media and [data-device] canvas rules instead of the render-time 'device'. Live editor typography sets the custom properties directly.
changes.metric: HTML bytes, Style & Layout, TBT, hydration CPU
changes.expected_effect: HTML -57 KB raw / -5.6 KB gz (prod), -61.7 KB raw (fixture); -148 descendant :is() rules; with HW-1, measured no-JS mobile TBT median 158 -> 25 ms and Style&Layout 401 -> 276 ms; removes device-dependent CSS text churn (25 <style> swaps on mobile device switch, hydration H6)
changes.estimate_basis: prod-variants.py typo step; template extraction (148 rules -> 26 templates); ab-prod.sh P0 vs P3 (N=5 gzip, N=3 br)
changes.risk_notes: Visual parity across live editor preview, builder canvas device simulation (buildLiveWidgetTypographyCss ancestors), dark/light mode and the 1px-unreadable fallback chain (pickFontSize). Specificity is kept identical in v1; the @layer cleanup of the triple-attribute hack is a follow-up. Conflicts with hydration H10 (same file, ChromeWidgetView.tsx).
changes.verification: Computed-style parity probe over all [data-w-id] descendants at 3 widths x 2 modes: zero diff. Snapshot tests of the template. Fixture document: zero '<style>[data-w-id=' blocks. measure-ab.sh: TBT and main-thread deltas.

changes.title: Dehydration diet: project query results in the query functions (menu top level, post locale, newsletter inline, settings boot set, no CSS-snapshot inputs)
changes.mechanism: (a) New public menu server fn and query key (key, lang) that returns only rendered fields (id, parent_id, position, item_type, label in lang with fallback, href; target/visibility/icon/css_class/mega only when not default). SSR seeds top-level rows with has_children; children are fetched on pointerenter/focus with an idle prefetch. Admin MenuManager keeps menuWithItemsQueryOptions. (b) Post-list, slider, rated-list rows: title/excerpt of the key's lang with fallback, other language dropped; header_ticker key gains lang. (c) newsletterInlineSettingsQueryOptions with an explicit select list; the lazy popup reads the full row. (d) The site_settings map dehydrates a boot key set with a partial marker; useSiteSetting(key outside boot set) enables a full-map fetch. A test records the keys read during the SSR render of /, a post and a category. (e) site_global_colors and site_design_tokens are not prefetched/dehydrated for anon; useDeferredStyleCss keeps the SSR snapshot while data is undefined (fetch only for staff/live-sync). (f) Optional, later: strip *_en siblings in builder docs with a lang-aware home-page key.
changes.metric: HTML bytes, inline script eval, hydrate(), post-hydration requests, TBT
changes.expected_effect: State -61 KB raw / -10.8 KB gz on prod (117.2 -> 56.2 KB raw, 25.9 -> 15.1 KB gz); fixture -29 KB raw / -4.1 KB gz; barrier eval about halved; -2 PostgREST requests after hydration from (e); the TBT share is inside the measured -130 ms (P0->P1 no-JS median 103 -> 86 ms)
changes.estimate_basis: trim-sim.mjs per-step deltas re-serialized with the repo's seroval; prod-variants.py F1_state on the real HTML (-69 KB raw / -14.5 KB gz including stream and bootstrap)
changes.risk_notes: Consumer shape changes (types). Keys without lang must not be locale-projected because the language switch is a soft router.navigate (switchUiLanguage.ts:163). An omitted settings key read during the first render would cause a hydration mismatch, so the key-read recorder gate is mandatory. Menu children fetched on intent need an idle prefetch to avoid a first-hover delay. Conflicts with hydration H2 (useGlobalColors/designTokens) and server-cache SC-8 (homepage bundle RPC must seed the projected keys).
changes.verification: Decode $tsr from the fixture and production HTML (decode-all.cjs + trim-steps): per-key budgets met. No console hydration errors in first-visit-harness. Menu opens with children after hover. EN switch shows EN labels. measure-ab.sh: TBT/main-thread not worse and post-hydration fetch count down by 2.

changes.title: srcset ladders matched to slot widths; avatars 1x/2x
changes.mechanism: Default RESPONSIVE_WIDTHS (cropSizes.ts:209) 9 -> 4-5 widths (e.g. 480/768/1280/1920), or derive the ladder from the sizes attribute (max slot px x DPR 1..2). buildAvatarSrcSet (cropSizes.ts:254-257) drops 3x. The coverPreload imageSrcSet uses the same ladder, so the preload and the img stay identical.

The server-cache SC-10 Link-header change reuses the same helper.

changes.title: Repeated static inline style attributes -> classes
changes.mechanism: Move the constant parts of the AuthorByline avatar style (163 B x33), the widget frame stretch style (128 B x23), the FillImage transition (143 B x21) and the multi-card width calc (101 B x20) into classes. Keep only the per-instance values as custom properties.
changes.estimate_basis: repeated style-value census (19 values >=5x, 327 occurrences, 33.7 KB) and transform F5_styleattr
changes.risk_notes: Inline style beats class specificity, so existing !important rules must be reviewed for precedence changes.
changes.verification: Computed-style parity probe; regions.py main markup about -33 KB.

changes.title: Gates: per-component document budgets, dehydrated payload budgets and forbidden fields, inline typography blocks = 0
changes.mechanism: Extend the measurement workstream's document-weight gate. Decode $tsr with seroval in node, report per-query bytes against per-key ratchets, and assert absence of menu_id, default mega_config, *_en fields in PL post rows and popup_* in the dehydrated newsletter. Count inline <style> blocks containing [data-w-id= (must be 0) and cap total inline CSS. Add a unit test that renders / , a post and a category SSR with a recording settings map and asserts the read keys are a subset of the boot set.
changes.metric: durability (prevents regression of all the above)
changes.expected_effect: Turns the HW-1..HW-6 savings into a ratchet; zero runtime cost
changes.estimate_basis: ssrBudgets.ts:30-50 states payload size is not statically measurable; this artifact-level gate closes that gap
changes.risk_notes: The fixture differs from production (no menu or srcset data), so budgets are structural and need a production-HTML mode (--html).
changes.verification: Negative control: re-adding select('*') or a typography <style> turns the gate red.

changes.title: (stretch, repeat visits only) brand custom properties as a hashed external sheet; speculation rules via header
changes.mechanism: Serve the tenant token CSS at /__nes/tokens.<css-hash>.css (immutable) linked in head instead of 7.5 KB inline. Move the 2.3 KB speculationrules JSON to a Speculation-Rules response header pointing at a static JSON.
changes.expected_effect: -7.5 KB raw / -1.2 KB gz HTML; 0 on Lighthouse cold load (it adds a parallel render-blocking request)
changes.risk_notes: Adds an RTT on the first visit; the hash must match useDeferredStyleCss. Not a score lever: schedule last or skip.
changes.verification: Repeat-visit transfer in DevTools; LH cold load not worse in A/B.

open_questions: Which site_settings keys are read during the first render of post/category/page routes (key_takeaways on posts)? The HW-3d boot set must come from the key-read recorder test, not from grep.
Device-class SSR (drop the 37 KB display:none desktop header from mobile documents) needs a cache-key split and loses desktop nav links in the mobile HTML. Human decision; not proposed for this PR.
Make the four top-level menu items with children (/analizy, /wydarzenia, /membership-join, /o-nas) real links plus a disclosure button? It is an SEO improvement, product decision.
Should the 3.35 KB footer-navigation ItemList JSON-LD stay? It is SEO-owned; no score effect.
